name: Afamolla

queries.query: Bangladesh official cadastral parcel map GIS land records DLRS Afamolla
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) official Khatian/Map pages, the Online Land Records and Survey Management map search, and the official DLRS Map Portal. Search results also located an official Shariatpur district record-room page and an official Bhedarganj/union land-office reference, placing the WUP point in the Shariatpur/Bhedarganj administrative context.

queries.result: Bangla first-party discovery identified the official DLRS Bangla Khatian/Map service, Shariatpur district record-room information, Bhedarganj official pages, and a union land-office page describing cadastral khatian/CS records. No official Bangla result exposed an Afamolla parcel identifier or downloadable polygon.

registryEvidence.custodian: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Bangladesh; local administrative record context is Shariatpur District / Bhedarganj Upazila, with union land offices and the district record room referenced by official government pages.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official DLRS/Settlement services evidence a national cadastral map and khatian procedure and the official Shariatpur pages evidence local record-room and land-office custodians. This does not establish open citywide parcel geometry completeness or that Afamolla has a published digital mouza layer.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bangladesh DLRS/Settlement official map, khatian, and mouza-map services; local context Shariatpur District and Bhedarganj Upazila.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service existence and current route/schema behavior were verified. No Afamolla parcel feature, native parcel ID, CRS, or polygon was verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned and source-proven
uncertainty: Afamolla is a WUP place label and the exact WUP point was preserved; no coordinate was shifted to seek a hit.
The empty Shariatpur survey response and zero Afamolla mouza search are service-result limits, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The official viewer documents parcel tile routes and a Dag_No display field, but no anonymous Afamolla parcel response was available to qualify its native identity or geometry.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
